pricingFaq.q1: Do members pay to use Unytea?
pricingFaq.a1: No. Members can create an account, explore communities, and join for free. They only pay if a host charges for community access or sells a course.
pricingFaq.a2: Transaction fees apply only when you sell paid community access or courses through Unytea.
pricingFaq.a3: Yes. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial — no credit card required. At day 14, if you haven't added payment, your community is paywalled (your data stays safe, members just can't interact) until you add a card. You can come back any time.
pricingFaq.a4: Yes. You can upgrade as your community grows and unlock lower transaction fees, more tools, and more operational control.
pricingFaq.a5: Pro is for operators managing multiple communities, brands, or teams that need white-labeling, API access, and zero transaction fees.
